messages:
casey-sales: Hearthline CTO asked for a short POC next week. Goals: sustained 300 qps, p95 < 350ms, p99 < 700ms, and CMK for embeddings. Need runbook + one-page cost summary.

nina-eng: We should run hosted control and a dedicated profile. Sequence lengths?

casey-sales: They provided traces: median 200 tokens in, 120 out; 70% session reuse.

nina-eng: Good for prefix caching. Rough capacity: ~96k tokens/s -> ~8 GPUs @12k tok/s each with headroom.

lee-ops: Draft runbook: 30m steady @300 qps, 10m 3x microburst, 5 coldstart cycles, KMS rotation test. Enable KV cache, batching cap 20ms, pre-warm 1 standby node.

otto-sre: KMS note: CMK supported on Dedicated/Private. kms-bot: "KMS: CMK OK on Dedicated/Private; hosted uses envelope encryption."

casey-sales: Procurement wants a 12mo committed number and a 1mo hosted PoC price. Lee, can you ballpark?

lee-ops: Preliminary: Dedicated (8 GPUs reserved + infra/support) ~"$72k/month"; Hosted PoC (1mo managed) ~"$24k". I'll finalize after resource sizing.

nina-eng: We'll include sensitivity: 4-bit quant, reduced context, and caching can cut GPUs by ~25%.

casey-sales: Great. Please finalize runbook by Mon EOD and I'll send to Hearthline. Ping when results are in. :thumbsup:
